# Tiling report (real slides; generated by scripts/06_tiling_qc_report.py)

Slides processed: 203 / 203.

## Slide size at 20x and tissue tiles (224 px, stride 224, >= 50% tissue)

- Width x height at 20x: median 16249 x 14410 px (max 16250 x 16250).
- Tissue tiles per slide: median 1871, IQR 1466-2246, range 131-3067.
- Slides truncated by a max_tiles cap: 256: 100%, 1024: 89%, 2048: 35%, 4096: 0%, 8192: 0%.

| Subtype | Slides | Min | Median | Max |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In situ | 45 | 131 | 1427 | 2818 |
| Lepidic | 19 | 901 | 1774 | 2486 |
| Acinar | 30 | 768 | 2029 | 2971 |
| Papillary | 39 | 428 | 1790 | 2842 |
| Micropapillary | 26 | 1179 | 2042 | 3067 |
| Solid | 29 | 1320 | 2153 | 2978 |
| Cribriform | 15 | 687 | 2021 | 2662 |

## Timing (this run)

- Download: median 9.0 s/slide; decode at 20x: median 16.2 s; tissue mask + grid: median 0.9 s.
- Encoder time per tile on this hardware: phikonv2 175 ms, phikon 51 ms, lunit_dino 15 ms.

## Projection for the headline run (Kaggle 2x T4, cap 4096)

- Tiles to embed with cap 4096: 368,243 (vs 51,843 in this pilot).
- CPU-side decode for 203 slides: ~0.9 h, overlapped with encoding by the decode-ahead thread.
- GPU encode time depends on T4 throughput (not measurable here); the stage-1 notebook prints per-model tiles/s after the 2-slide smoke test, and `--summarize` totals them.
